section_summary: Pages 106-153 contain narcotics-control material on Japan. They include United Nations circulars forwarding Japan's Marihuana Control Regulations and 1946 annual narcotics report, and a March 1948 despatch and Department instruction on coca leaf cultivation, with SCAPIN 130 and Ministry of Welfare Ordinance No. 46. The rest is a Treasury Bureau of Narcotics transmittal and Permanent Central Opium Board statistical forms for Japan, Korea and the Ryukyu Islands, mostly reporting nil imports and exports.

subfiles.about: Cover of UN document on Japanese narcotics laws communicated by the US.
subfiles.summary: UN cover sheet for Japanese law communicated by the US under the 1931 Convention, stamped by State Department.
subfiles.title: UN cover: Japan laws and regulations, Marihuana Control

subfiles.about: Note forwarding a US-communicated law under Article 21 of the 1931 Convention.
subfiles.summary: Document header and note by the Secretary-General forwarding the law; page 109 blank.
subfiles.title: UN document E/NL.1947/18 and Secretary-General note

subfiles.about: Japanese ordinance regulating cultivation and licensing of marihuana, from the Official Gazette.
subfiles.from: Ministries of Welfare and Agriculture and Forestry
subfiles.summary: Ordinance supersedes earlier Welfare ordinances. It bans marihuana acts except under licensed producers and research workers. It sets licensing, fees, registers, monthly reports, inspection and penalties up to three years or 5,000 yen.
subfiles.title: Marihuana Control Regulations, Ordinance No. 1

subfiles.about: Cover of Japan's 1946 annual narcotics report.
subfiles.summary: UN cover for Japan's 1946 annual report communicated by the US.
subfiles.title: UN cover: Annual Report of Japan for 1946

subfiles.about: Note forwarding the annual report under the 1931 Convention.
subfiles.summary: Document header and Secretary-General's note; page 117 blank.
subfiles.title: UN document E/NR.1946/12 and Secretary-General note

subfiles.about: Annual report on Japan's narcotics control and traffic for 1946.
subfiles.summary: Describes narcotic control regulations, agencies and agents, seizures of smuggled opium, prosecutions, confiscations and illicit prices. Notes prohibition of poppy, coca and hemp cultivation except licensed fibre hemp, and lists registered dealers (85,881). Covers storage, education and destruction of heroin.
subfiles.title: SCAP report on traffic in opium and dangerous drugs, 1946

subfiles.about: Reports no coca cultivation in Japan, prohibited by SCAPIN 130 and Ministry of Welfare regulation 46.
subfiles.from: W. J. Sebald, US Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Replies to UN questionnaire; asks Department to inform Secretary-General that Japan has no coca cultivation, enclosing SCAPIN 130 and Regulation 46.
subfiles.title: Despatch 139: Questionnaire on Coca Leaf Production

subfiles.about: Directive prohibiting narcotic plant cultivation, import, export and manufacture.
subfiles.summary: Prohibits planting narcotic plants and orders destruction, bans export/manufacture and unauthorised import, freezes stocks and preserves records; defines narcotics and persons.
subfiles.title: Enclosure 1: SCAPIN 130 Control of Narcotic Products
subfiles.to: Imperial Japanese Government through Central Liaison Office, Tokyo

subfiles.about: Translation of ordinance prohibiting narcotic plant cultivation and manufacture, import and export.
subfiles.summary: Defines narcotics, prohibits cultivation, manufacture, import, export and removal or sale without permission, and sets penalties up to three years and 5,000 yen.
subfiles.title: Enclosure 2: Ministry of Welfare Ordinance No. 46

subfiles.about: Asks representative to send note to UN Secretary-General that Japan has no coca cultivation.
subfiles.summary: Gives draft wording for note replying to the coca questionnaire, citing SCAPIN 130 and Regulation 46.
subfiles.title: Department instruction to US Representative to UN on coca leaf
subfiles.to: United States Representative to the United Nations, New York

subfiles.about: Forwards Japan, Korea and Ryukyus statistical forms for the Permanent Central Opium Board.
subfiles.from: Acting Commissioner of Narcotics, Treasury Department
subfiles.summary: Encloses Forms A(GL) for third and fourth quarters 1947 and Form B(G) for 1948 for transmission to the Board.
subfiles.title: Treasury letter transmitting statistical forms
subfiles.to: George A. Morlock, Department of State

subfiles.about: Quarterly import/export statistics for Japan, third quarter 1947.
subfiles.from: GHQ SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Sams)
subfiles.summary: Printed form with notes; all import and export entries are nil.
subfiles.title: Japan Form A(GL) third quarter 1947

subfiles.about: Quarterly statistics for Japan, fourth quarter 1947.
subfiles.from: GHQ SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Sams)
subfiles.summary: Printed form with notes; all entries nil.
subfiles.title: Japan Form A(GL) fourth quarter 1947

subfiles.about: Annual estimates of raw material imports for Japan.
subfiles.from: GHQ SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Sams)
subfiles.summary: Form B with Article 21 extract, estimates nil, and definitions and notes.
subfiles.title: Japan Form B(G) annual estimates 1948

subfiles.about: Quarterly statistics for Korea, third quarter 1947.
subfiles.from: US Military Government in Korea (Y. S. Lee)
subfiles.summary: Form with nil imports and exports; remarks confirm verbal report and no narcotics imported or exported.
subfiles.title: Korea Form A(GL) third quarter 1947

subfiles.about: Quarterly statistics for Korea, fourth quarter 1947.
subfiles.from: US Military Government in Korea (Y. S. Lee)

subfiles.title: Korea Form A(GL) fourth quarter 1947

subfiles.about: Annual estimates of narcotic drug imports for Korea, 1948.
subfiles.from: US Military Government in Korea (Y. S. Lee)
subfiles.summary: Raw material estimates nil, with small manufactured drug estimates based on 1936-1945 average consumption; definitions page.
subfiles.title: Korea Form B(G) annual estimates 1948

subfiles.about: Quarterly statistics for the Ryukyus, third quarter 1947.
subfiles.from: Ryukyus Islands Government Public Health (Williams Smith)
subfiles.summary: Form A with nil imports and exports; continues beyond this section.
subfiles.title: Ryukyus Form A(GL) third quarter 1947
